messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell doctor if have history of diabetic retinopathy"
set: ["tell doctor if have history of diabetic retinopathy", "diabetic retinopathy complications", "tell your doctor if you have a history of drug or alcohol addiction", "tell doctor about history of heart disease", "tell doctor about history of narrow-angle glaucoma", "tell your doctor if you have a history of seizures before starting this medicine", "tell doctor about history of seizures or epilepsy", "tell doctor about history of recent heart attack", "tell doctor about history of long QT syndrome", "tell your doctor if you have diabetes", "tell doctor if have or had pregnancy", "tell your doctor if you have phenylketonuria", "tell doctor about history of liver or kidney disease", "tell doctor about history of bipolar disorder (manic depression)", "tell doctor if have or had liver problems", "tell doctor if have or had heart problems"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
